Hymn 168: As the Shadows Fall
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major

This is hymn number 168 titled "As the Shadows Fall" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lorin F. Wheelwright and the lyrics were written by Lorin F. Wheelwright.
